findings.why_it_matters: A wrong headline figure misleads every downstream reader. Figures, tables, or conclusions built on this number inherit the error.

findings.claim_text: Patients whose tumors had the highest ER-alpha protein responded best to hormone therapy, which suggests protein data could guide treatment research.
findings.limitation: clinical.tsv records radiation_therapy, targeted_molecular_therapy, and additional_pharmaceutical_therapy as yes/no flags, plus new_tumor_event_after_initial_treatment and days_to_new_tumor_event, but it has no hormone-therapy records and no response measure. Verifying this claim would require a treated cohort like METABRIC or a neo-adjuvant endocrine therapy trial with response annotations.
findings.why_it_matters: The TCGA-BRCA release does not record what this sentence requires. Any downstream use of the claim rests on evidence the data does not contain.
findings.next_step: Remove or reword the sentence, or rerun the analysis against a dataset that records what the claim requires (for treatment-response claims, consider METABRIC or a neo-adjuvant endocrine therapy trial).
